text:
Renee (Finance Ops): BlueCrest invoice INV-2026-011 is 70 days overdue; card declined. They pinged us asking for a short plan to avoid suspension.

Omar (AE): Jules (their finance) says they had duplicate charge issues with their payroll vendor, cashflow strained this month. Usage steady. Customer asks for 60-day split.

Talia (Collections): We require a PO or CFO email + proof of payment method for any split. Recommend 3-part plan (33/33/34) with first wire within 48h.

Liam (Collections Lead): Agreed. Conditions: PO to billing@redwood.com, signed email from CFO, wire receipt for first tranche. Waive late fees once first payment posts; apply 0.9% monthly admin fee on outstanding. Suspension scheduled in 7 days if conditions unmet.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-011 | Amount: $27,600 | Due: 2026-01-10 | Status: Past due (70d) | Last payment: none

Jules (BlueCrest): CFO signed PO attached to my email, wire started for $9,108 (33%). Will share receipt. Appreciate flexibility.

Renee (Finance Ops): Noted. Waiting for receipt to post partial payment.

Talia (Collections): Received wire confirmation 12h later. Marked partial payment and created payment-plan bluecrest-3x-INV-2026-011. Added watch label and reminders.

Omar (AE): Customer grateful. I'll follow up on remaining installments.

Liam (Collections Lead): Logged in tracker. If installment 2 misses, escalate to legal + service hold. Closing thread unless something changes.
